title: Interview: Nvidia backs UK quantum startup Riverlane to solve latency, computing bottlenecks
content: As technology giants pour billions of dollars and research resources into deep-tech fields such as quantum computing, UK startup Riverlane is drawing attention after receiving investment from Nvidia. In an interview with DIGITIMES at the 2026 UK National Quantum Technologies Showcase, Riverlane CEO Steve Brierley discussed how the company is working with Nvidia and other chip giants to overcome quantum computing's low-latency and intensive computing challenges.

title: Wintoys 3.0 Takes Aim At Windows 11’s AI Memory Usage, Developer Reports Up To 6GB RAM Savings
content: Windows optimization utility Wintoys has received a major 3.0 update, introducing dedicated controls for Windows 11's AI features, improved performance tweaks, Group Policy synchronization, and long-awaited configuration profiles. The free utility, developed by Bogdan Pătrăucean, allows Windows 10 and Windows 11 users to manage system settings, uninstall applications, optimize performance, and control privacy-related features through a modern WinUI 3 interface. title: Jim Cramer Calls It An Insult To NVIDIA’s 49,000 Employees To Think The Company Is Nothing Without The “Guy With A Leather Jacket,” Doubles Down On Support For Interim CEO
content: While Elon Musk and several semiconductor analysts warn that NVIDIA’s supply chain could unravel without Jensen Huang at the helm, CNBC host Jim Cramer is taking the exact opposite stance, arguing that the GPU manufacturer is in even better hands under interim CEO Colette Kress.
